description: A `derived=@sig` machine declares no projection rules. Per §51.9 a derived machine must map source variants onto its own enum, so the empty projection is rejected with E-ENGINE-005 (§34: Error). NOTE: this source also emits E-ENGINE-STATE-CHILD-MISSING as cascade noise from the empty body; the codes-half is a SUPERSET check so the case stays precise about E-ENGINE-005. The -neg twin (same declaration WITH projection rules) emits zero errors, which is what proves the cascade is a consequence of the rejected empty body and not a false-fire on a legal derived declaration.
rationale: §51.9 — a DERIVED machine projects a source machine's variants onto its own enum. A derived declaration with an empty body declares a projection that maps nothing, so the projected variable has no defined value for any source state. The empty body is rejected rather than defaulted, because there is no non-arbitrary choice of target variant.
